benchmark_metadata.benchmark_type: v3.2.1 with Datadog Extension vs v3.2.0 baseline

analysis.dmg_size_impact: DMG increased by ~120MB (90%), indicating significant compression overhead
analysis.initramfs_efficiency: Datadog extension added as 41MB uncompressed but only increased initramfs by 3MB (93% compression ratio)
analysis.overhead_assessment: Minimal runtime overhead expected; extension features available offline for static analysis

recommendations.for_users: Download v3.2.1 for Datadog extension features; static analysis works offline
recommendations.for_developers: 41MB uncompressed extension size justified by feature set; initramfs compression efficient
recommendations.performance_testing: Recommend measuring CPU, memory, and network impact during actual Datadog cloud integration
